text:
Which statement describes how a diode operates in an electrical circuit?
A
When the temperature increases, its resistance increases.
B
When the current becomes too high, it melts and cuts off the current.
C
It only allows current in one direction.
D
It uses a low-current circuit to switch on a circuit carrying a much larger current.

options.label: A
options.text: When the temperature increases, its resistance increases.

options.label: B
options.text: When the current becomes too high, it melts and cuts off the current.

options.label: C
options.text: It only allows current in one direction.

options.label: D
options.text: It uses a low-current circuit to switch on a circuit carrying a much larger current.
